name: KNN-based Grouping for SH-AC Residuals
definition: A grouping algorithm that clusters 45 SH-AC residual dimensions into non-overlapping groups based on similarity of residual patterns, performed on residual coefficients from the first-stage VQ rather than original coefficients.
summary: KNN-based Grouping for SH-AC Residuals clusters 45-dimensional residuals by pattern similarity to enable efficient entropy coding via separate codebooks.
